questions.question: A prophet asked why God's people were doing something to one another, though they share one Father. What was it?
According to the prophet, how did Judah disgrace the LORD's beloved sanctuary?

answers.text: By marrying the daughter of a foreign god
By bowing down to the idol of a foreign god
By burning incense to the image of a foreign god

questions.question: A prophet said the people of Judah covered the LORD's altar with weeping and groaning. Why were they so upset?

answers.text: The LORD no longer received their offerings gladly
Their enemies had broken down the city walls
The rain had stopped falling on their fields
